nav.$comment: An application's navigation (1.10, 0110): rows of links as tall as a control, on whatever surface the application stands them on — it paints none. The current screen is three channels at once, a tint, a bar at the start edge and a weight, so no single one carries it: the tint is the first the forced-colours mode drops, and the bar and the weight survive it.

link-bg-hover.$description: Background of a link under the pointer.

link-bg-current.$description: Background of the link to the current screen.

link-fg-current.$description: Text colour of the link to the current screen.

link-font-weight-current.$description: Font weight of the link to the current screen.

link-gap.$description: Gap between a link's icon and its name.

marker-color.$description: Colour of the bar at the start edge of the link to the current screen.

marker-width.$description: Width of the bar marking the current screen.

marker-inset.$description: How far the bar marking the current screen stands in from the link's top and bottom.
